title: Crazy Mythicals Texture Pack
description: Adds models for Mythicals from the Crazy Mythicals plugin
body:
Adds the following weapons:
- Burgblade
- Thornblade
- Ghost Shield
- Dragon Cannon
- The Judge
- Hourglass Dagger
- Great Hammer
- Cleaver
- Soul Staff

If you want to put the pack on your server use this plugin: https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/resource-pack-manager.118574/
